messages:
incident-bot: PAGER: Dedicated pool 'bluecliff-prod-gpu' capacity alarm triggered (GPU utilization >= 99%, queue length 842). Severity: P1. Paging oncall (maria).

maria (oncall): seeing it. investigating.

maria (oncall): quick metrics: 100% GPU util on pool, backlog on q=app-requests-bluecliff up ~x40 in last 6m, autoscaler attempted scale but hit 'pool_max_instances' limit.

maria (oncall): logs: 
```
[2393001200] pool/bluecliff-prod-gpu: instance_count=8 max_instances=8
[2393001220] autoscaler: scale_request(+2) -> denied (quota limit)
[2393001245] router: enqueue request tenant=bluecliff, prioritized=false
```

chris (sre): do we have burst-to-shared enabled for this tenant? I think Bluecliff is set to deny overflow by default.

devon (infra): correct, policy 'no-overflow' is set on the tenant due to compliance (VPC/private routing). That blocks fallback to shared pools.

maria (oncall): customer impact: their web agents are seeing timeouts ~504s after 30s queue TTL. Support tickets incoming. Need mitigation asap, either allow limited overflow or throttle customer concurrency.

leo (eng-runtime): quick option list: 1) temporarily allow overflow-to-shared with strict tag isolation + limit to N concurrent jobs; 2) enforce global concurrency cap for the tenant to preserve latency for higher priority requests; 3) preempt non-interactive batch jobs and drain to disk.

maria (oncall): can we flip overflow for only high-priority routes? maybe allow 'interactive' set to overflow, keep batch blocked.

devon (infra): we have route-level labels. Bluecliff uses /api/v1/generate for interactive (low token). Batch pipeline uses /internal/embeds. We can toggle at router policy.

maria (oncall): I'm going to propose a temporary mitigation: enable overflow->shared for interactive routes only, with concurrency limit 10 and rate-limit 50 r/s, and enable preemptible flag to prefer ephemeral instances. That keeps sensitive data paths mostly on VPC traffic but allows UX to recover. Approve?

chris (sre): +1 but note: shared pool means data egress crosses different host tenancy; need to add strong tagging and log audit. sasha should approve from acct mgmt side (billing/credits).

sasha (acct mgmt): on it, I'm already on call with Bluecliff. they want availability. they accept a temporary change if we mark it as non-persistent and promise follow-up.

maria (oncall): executing change now. will run control-plane API call to update router policy.

maria (oncall): running: 
```
curl -X PATCH https://control-plane.internal/api/v1/tenants/bluecliff/policy \ 
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN' \ 
  -d '{"overflow_policy":"allow_shared_interactive","concurrency_limit":10,"rate_limit_rps":50,"preemptible":true}'
```

deploy-bot: policy update request accepted, job id 8483921.

maria (oncall): applied. monitoring in progress.

maria (oncall): immediate metrics: queue dropped from 842 -> 120 in 90s, 95th latency for interactive routes down from 4.2s -> 0.9s.

leo (eng-runtime): good. watching for cross-tenant error spikes. enabling additional audit logs for bluecliff sessions.

devon (infra): adding a temporary egress ACL so shared pool actors can only fetch models allowed by Bluecliff's policy.

maria (oncall): also applying a conservative concurrency cap at router: 
```
routerctl set-tenant-capacity bluecliff --concurrency 2 --for-route /internal/embeds --reason "mitigation: batch throttle"
```

chris (sre): will also throttle low-priority jobs: preempt jobs older than 30s in the queue.

incident-bot: NOTE: On-call handoff scheduled in 30m. Next oncall: chris.

maria (oncall): handing off to chris in 20m. key actions done: overflow enabled for interactive only, concurrency caps on batch, temporary ACLs, audit logging turned on. customer notified (Sasha).

sasha (acct mgmt): Bluecliff confirmed reduced errors on their side. asked for incident reference INC-2026-482. requesting ETA for permanent capacity increase.

chris (sre): taking over. I'll keep mitigation active. immediate next steps: 1) maintain overflow policy until EOD PT; 2) schedule capacity bump during maintenance window tomorrow 02:00 UTC to add +4 GPUs to pool; 3) prepare postmortem and auto-scaler policy change to avoid hard max blocking.

leo (eng-runtime): action item: change autoscaler to prioritize scaling within 60s and surface quota-block alerts earlier. PR draft: https://stash.internal/redwood/infra/PR-1142

devon (infra): assigned infra ticket INF-3319 to raise pool max and check quota config.

maria (oncall): adding short note to #status-email draft to customer: "Temporary overflow enabled to restore interactive availability. We will revert overflow when pool capacity is increased and provide a full RCA." Sasha, please send.

sasha (acct mgmt): sending now to Bluecliff.

chris (sre): leaving final note before shift change: mitigation stable for 10m, no cross-tenant errors observed, queue trending down. I'll escalate if any regression.

maria (oncall): thx team. tagging postmortem owners: leo, devon, chris. schedule postmortem for 48h.

incident-bot: Incident ack logged. Severity downgraded to P2 at 2393001620 (after mitigation).

chris (sre): handoff complete. maria, handing back to you for wrap?

maria (oncall): thanks, I'm offsite after 10m. confirmed all notes in incident ticket.

sasha (acct mgmt): Bluecliff follow-up: asked for committed next steps and a temporary SLA credit. I'm coordinating legal.

leo (eng-runtime): final runbook TODOs: 1) add 'soft-quota' escalation within autoscaler, 2) add tenant-level overflow decision log in console, 3) add integration test for policy flip.

chris (sre): closing thread here; will update incident ticket and move to postmortem channel when available.
